args.body: Take CATALOGUE-EXAMPLE-RECONCILE-RELEASE-BASELINE under a valid lease. Check the original placement mission and competing ownership before editing. Reuse the staged bilingual example and, if committed, products/distribution/catalogue-example-baseline-reconciliation/director-diff.json. Match the differing hunks to verified release evidence or pending changes before choosing integration or the mission's offline overlay. If integration is safe, verify exact reversal, working links and both languages against the rehearsal, including manual row lookup and comparison. Obtain a dry-run digest and route that exact candidate for host-enforced independent review. If the checkout is contested, verify the overlay against the captured live bytes and document the specific change or ownership decision that would permit integration. Read back the result and close with a lesson. No deployment, external contact or spending.
